purpose: Reassess the measurement architecture of the qualitative government-securities supply-pressure concept after exact Ministry source retention and ECB denominator-candidate testing failed to justify a one-to-one stock-normalised scalar.

evidence_base.title: Bid-to-cover and yield changes around public debt auctions in the euro area
evidence_base.design_implication: Auction absorption outcomes, especially bid-to-cover, are empirically relevant to post-auction secondary-market yields and should remain distinct from ex-ante supply.

evidence_base.title: Price effects of sovereign debt auctions in the Euro-zone: the role of the crisis
evidence_base.design_implication: Secondary-market yields can move in anticipation of auctions and the effect depends on supply relative to demand, supporting separate pre-auction supply and post-auction absorption observables.

evidence_base.institution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
evidence_base.title: Duration Risk versus Local Supply Channel in Treasury Yields
evidence_base.design_implication: Local notional supply and duration risk are distinct channels and should not be collapsed into a single amount-only measure.

evidence_base.title: The yield curve impact of government debt issuance surprises and the implications for QT
evidence_base.design_implication: Unexpected issuance changes are conceptually distinct from announced levels and can operate through both local-supply and duration-risk channels.

evidence_base.title: Bond supply, yield drifts and liquidity provision before macroeconomic announcements
evidence_base.design_implication: Dealer inventory and liquidity conditions can alter the yield impact of issuance, so liquidity belongs in context/moderation rather than being relabelled supply.

evidence_base.title: A Primer on Managing Sovereign Debt-Portfolio Risks
evidence_base.design_implication: Auction predictability, issuance size, maturity and investor demand are distinct design dimensions; published plans and calendars can inform expectation architecture but do not automatically reveal market expectations.

evidence_base.title: Indicative financing plan 2025
evidence_base.design_implication: Romania publishes indicative domestic issuance volumes at quarterly horizon and more specific prospectus terms, enabling a future official-plan revision measure but not a direct market-expectations surprise without an additional expectations source.

measurement_vector.concept: Nominal RON target amount explicitly announced ex ante for competitive Treasury-bill auctions and benchmark-bond reference auctions, excluding SSON capacity.
guards: SSON is excluded from the canonical full-year candidate because its information-time definition is not stable across 2025.
accepted or borrowed amount may not replace announced competitive target as ex-ante supply
retail and external issuance remain outside this market boundary
base-order announcements and later amendments must retain separate information dates and lineage
forward-scheduled events may not be relabelled completed-period realised supply

measurement_vector.concept: Nominal RON amount offered to the domestic primary market.
guards: accepted or borrowed amount may not replace announced amount as ex-ante supply
retail issuance may not be mixed into the interbank-auction series without an explicit boundary change
completed-period and forward-scheduled rows must be distinguished

measurement_vector.concept: Unexpected component of announced RON supply relative to information available immediately before the announcement.
guards: quarterly indicative financing volumes are not assumed to equal auction-specific market expectations
historical averages may not be relabelled expectations without preregistration
expectation source must be timestamped before the auction announcement

measurement_vector.concept: Interest-rate duration risk placed on the market by the announced auction basket.
guards: auction clearing yield is post-announcement/post-bidding and may not be used to construct an ex-ante duration shock
residual maturity alone may be retained as a descriptive composition vector but may not be called DV01 or duration
maturity buckets may not be aggregated with arbitrary weights

measurement_vector.concept: Demand submitted relative to announced supply.
guards: this is an auction outcome and may not be treated as exogenous supply
submitted and announced amounts must share currency/instrument/time boundary

measurement_vector.concept: Submitted demand relative to accepted auction amount using the Ministry published definition.
guards: bid-to-cover may not be inverted and relabelled as pure supply pressure
accepted amount remains a jointly determined auction outcome

measurement_vector.concept: Capacity of the secondary market to absorb and redistribute government securities.
Descriptive scale/capacity proxy for the domestic government-securities market.
guards: no capacity proxy is selected as the mandatory denominator for announced supply
valuation and issuance-channel differences must remain explicit
a ratio using a proxy may only be a named sensitivity diagnostic, never the generic pressure node by default

structural_topology.causal_identification_guard: Post-auction absorption outcomes may be jointly determined with yields and demand. They require separate identification before any causal supply-to-yield equation.

reference_mode_strategy.reason: The full-year comparable ex-ante measure is the competitive reference-auction target only. SSON is excluded because its 2025 information-time definition changes from fixed nominal capacity to an adjudication-dependent percentage.
source_hierarchy: Ministry issuance prospectus / auction announcement with exact indicative target amount
Ministry Flash Report exact auction table as cross-check
monthly public debt report only where exact native table mapping is reproducible

next_task.task: Recover exact official raw sources for the three remaining acts: OMF 1221/2025, OMF 1795/2025 and OMF 1998/2025. Do not infer August, the missing November base event row, or final December from web-index text or later outcomes.
